title: Synthetic taxpayer population, manual baseline and measured results
scope: Part 7 evidence: about 200 synthetic FMCG taxpayers with planted issues, a simulated manual baseline and a reproducible metrics report for the proposal's test results

acceptance.text: A seeded, reproducible generator writes about 200 synthetic taxpayers with known planted issues (valid structural refunds, fake invoices, untaxed imported services, disguised employment, related-party loss creation, policy-gap cases) and clean controls; every record carries the synthetic marker

A simulated manual baseline (every refund audited, evidence compiled by hand, with documented time assumptions) and a runner that reports detection rate, false-positive rate, fast-lane share of valid refunds, time to an investigation-ready case vs baseline, reconciliation accuracy and share of findings with a valid legal route

The report is committed under docs/evidence/TAX-118 with the seed, versions and an explicit limitations section (synthetic behaviour, low Lekuka coverage, no labelled RSL outcomes, limited CMA data, unverified legal routes); no metric is presented as real-world performance
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: The report is committed under docs/evidence/TAX-118 with the seed, versions and an explicit limitations section (synthetic behaviour, low Lekuka coverage, no labelled RSL outcomes, limited CMA data, unverified legal routes); no metric is presented as real-world performance

evidence.text: ai/evaluation/assurance_population.py, seed 20261106: 300 FMCG taxpayers x 24 months, 6,055 claims, 82% clean, planted fake invoices, untaxed imported services, disguised employment, related-party loss, policy gap and mixed cases, legitimate look-alikes and noise; every record synthetic; same seed reproduces identical hashes.

Simulated manual baseline time model (documented assumptions) and simple-rule baselines at M100k/M500k/M1m; ai/evaluation/assurance_benchmark.py reports detection, false positives, fast-lane share, time, recompute accuracy and legal-route routing, plus Lekuka 10/50/90% and no-score ablation.

docs/evidence/TAX-118/{manifest.json, dev_summary.json, results.json, RESULTS.md, errors.csv, human/}: seal, dev, freeze and single test run recorded with hashes and fingerprint; limitations section states synthetic data, same-author generator/rules, low Lekuka coverage, no RSL outcomes, limited CMA data, unverified routes. Test split: 86.1% planted issues found, 8.0% clean flagged, 94.0% lane accuracy.

PR https://github.com/Vati-AI/rsl-taxathon/pull/277. python3 scripts/dev.py check: Workspace checks passed; python3 scripts/quality.py: First-party quality checks passed (ruff, mypy, frontend build); validate.py passed.
